COMP 2200 - Introduction to Machine Learning

A comprehensive introduction to machine learning using Python, focusing on models, evaluation, and real-world applications. Students will explore how to select, validate, and implement models, examine performance metrics, and gain insights into research methodologies using various frameworks.

Prerequisite(s): COMP 1500  or COMP 1700  

Credit Hours: 3

Term Offered: Spring of even years
